hypothesis: QS>=50 alone (無 GQ gate) 作為 TO rescue 規則：預測 delta_F1=+0.008556 in 5kHz TO
key_observations: QS>=50 alone outperforms GQ+QS>=60 (+0.008556 vs +0.005551). HPP NOT discriminative in TO (52% TP vs 52% FP with HPP<0.05). CramersV near 0 for most TO candidates (useless in TO rescue). DORADO TO best rescue: only +0.000476 (almost no opportunity). H001/H002 predicted fail based on OBSERVE data. CramersV>0.3: 85.4% precision in TO but only 48 candidates.
feature_correlations_noted: HPP vs HP_Ratio confusion: TO haplotagging assigns most reads to one HP, making HPP near 0 universally (not FP-specific). AlleleDelta near 0 for both TP/FP in TO (different from paired data 5.29x ratio). QS scores cluster: no candidates with QS in [40,50), effective threshold is QS>=50.
human_notes: auto-adopted: delta_F1=+0.008556 exceeds threshold; QS>=50 alone as primary TO rescue rule

hypothesis: QS>=50+CramersV>0.15 組合 rescue：加入 CramersV 條件以提升 precision
key_observations: H004 大幅遜於 H011：CramersV>0 的 TO 候選只有 46/773 TP（6%），H004 是 H011 的嚴格子集。CramersV 中位數=0 in TO candidates（96% 為 0），加入 CramersV 條件實際上是截斷了 H011 的大量有效救援。Rescue precision 0.836 比 H011 的 0.769 高，但總 F1 增益只有 1/13 of H011。
feature_correlations_noted: CramersV>0.15 在 TO 候選中只有 55/1071（5.1%）— 絕大多數候選的 CramersV=0，CramersV 作為 rescue 過濾條件嚴重截斷樣本。
human_notes: auto-rejected: delta=+0.000663 << H011 delta=+0.008556; loses 596 TP for only +9 FP precision gain. CramersV is not useful as TO rescue filter.

hypothesis: PairwiseMedianDist>=0.20 在 GQ gate 後的附加效益（vs H011 QS>=50 alone）
key_observations: PMD>=0.10 alone: delta=+0.008787（比 H011 高 +0.000231）。BUT 正交性極差：H008(PMD>=0.20) 的 TP 中只有 16/408(3.9%) 是 H011 不包含的。組合(QS>=50 OR PMD>=0.20)只增加 +0.000209。PMD 與 QS 高度相關（共用 96.1% TP），非正交。PMD>=0.10 alone 略優 QS>=50，但 GQ gate 後（GQ>=10+PMD>=0.10: +0.006662）遠遜於 QS>=50 alone。
feature_correlations_noted: PMD 與 QS 高相關：PMD>=0.20 的候選中 96.1% 也通過 QS>=50；TP median PMD=0.210 vs FP median PMD=0.172，差距存在但不如 QS 精確。
human_notes: auto: PMD has positive signal but highly correlated with QS; only 3.9% unique candidates. Not worth adding as separate rescue rule. Can serve as supporting annotation: high PMD + QS corroboration.

hypothesis: CramersV>0.3 在 TO 中的 TP precision（與 paired 99.72% 比較）
key_observations: CramersV>0.3 在 TO 中 precision=85.4%（遠低於 paired 99.72%）。此 annotation 在 TO 下 CROSS-TRACK 不穩定。CramersV>0.3 的 TO 候選 100% 是 QS>=50 的子集（48/48），且僅占 TO candidates 的 4.5%（48/1071）。結論：CramersV>0.3 在 TO 可作為 'Strong signal' annotation，但不具 paired 的 99% 高精確度特性。
feature_correlations_noted: CramersV>0.3 在 TO 中的 precision(85.4%) vs paired(99.72%)，差距14.3%，顯示 CramersV annotation 跨 track 不穩定。CramersV=0 for 95.5% of TO candidates（中位數=0）。CramersV>0.3 完全包含於 QS>=50 中。
human_notes: auto: CramersV>0.3 is track-dependent (TO: 85.4% vs paired: 99.72%). Valid as 'high methylation signal' annotation in TO, but not as strict high-confidence filter. Confirmed cross-track instability.

hypothesis: VAF<0.08+AlleleDelta>0.05 作為 TO 的 FP-B2 精確過濾
key_observations: H005 在 TO 無效。原因：(1) TO rescue candidates 幾乎無 VAF<0.08（只有 7/773 TP, 12/298 FP），filter 觸發率 <1%；(2) AlleleDelta 在 TO 中兩組中位數極低（TP=0.0097, FP=0.0000），但比例差距無論對 FP 的 discriminative power 極弱；(3) 若作為 baseline filter 移除 AlleleDelta>0.05，反而造成 delta=-0.002170（165 TP removed, 56 FP removed）。此假設在 TO 下完全失效，與 OBSERVE 預測一致。
feature_correlations_noted: TO 的 AlleleDelta 接近 0 原因：TO haplotagging 導致大多數 reads 被分配到同一 HP，HP 間差距消失，AlleleDelta 失去判別力。此與 5kHz paired 的 5.29x ratio 形成對比。
human_notes: auto-rejected: H005 premise fails in TO (VAF<0.08 almost never triggered; AlleleDelta near 0 for all). As predicted by OBSERVE. Only valid in 5kHz paired track.

hypothesis: hp_assign_rate<0.5 作為 Low_Phase_Quality QC annotation
key_observations: hp_assign_rate 在 TO 有部分判別力：FP 率在低 hp 段較高（hp<0.2: 46.1% FP rate vs 全體 27.8%）。TP median=0.963 vs FP median=0.920，差距存在但不大。H011+hp>=0.5 filter 略降 delta（-0.000403），因 TP/FP 受影響比例相似（4.8% vs 5.2%）。hp_assign_rate<0.2 更有意義：46.1% FP rate，但只有193個候選。結論：annotation 有效（特別是<0.2門檻），作為 rescue QC 標記，不作為直接 F1 規則。
feature_correlations_noted: hp_assign_rate<0.2 group (N=193): 46.1% FP rate — significantly higher than overall 27.8%. This bin represents candidates where haplotagging mostly fails, giving unreliable methylation signals.
human_notes: auto: hp_assign_rate<0.2 (not <0.5) is the more useful threshold (46.1% FP rate). Adopt as Low_Phase_Quality annotation for hp_assign_rate<0.2. Not useful as rescue filter (H011+hp>=0.5 = -0.000403).

hypothesis: AlleleMethDelta = |HP1MethMean - HP2MethMean| 新特徵，修正 AlleleDelta HP 不均虛高問題
key_observations: AlleleMethDelta 完全無判別力於 TO。TP median=0.0311 vs FP median=0.0396（FP 略高！）。AUROC=0.473（接近 random）。Mann-Whitney p=0.778（無差異）。結論：在 TO 中，HP 分配本身就是噪音（haplotagging 不可靠），因此無論是 AlleleDelta 還是 AlleleMethDelta，HP 間差異都不代表真實等位基因甲基化差異。W2 弱點（AlleleDelta 虛高）在 TO 下不適用，因為 TO haplotagging 根本問題更根本。
feature_correlations_noted: TO haplotagging 使大多數 reads 被分配到 HP1，導致 HP2 reads 很少（min reads per HP=2 以上才計算）。此結構性問題使所有 HP-based 差異特徵（AlleleDelta, AlleleMethDelta, HPMergedDelta）在 TO 均無效。
human_notes: auto-rejected: AlleleMethDelta AUROC=0.473 in TO (random). FP median actually higher than TP. TO haplotagging is fundamentally unreliable for HP-based methylation features. W2 weakness fix does not apply to TO track.

hypothesis: GQ>=3 作為 TO rescue 規則（從 GQ 掃描自動發現）
key_observations: GQ>=3 rescue: delta=+0.009365 > H011(+0.008556). GQ>=5: +0.008840. GQ>=0(all): +0.009692. QS>=50 is strict subset of GQ>=3 (all QS>=50 candidates have GQ>=3). Extra candidates in GQ>=3 but not QS>=50: 86 TP / 62 FP = 58.1% precision (< baseline 70.6%). H012 trades precision for recall. ISM only covers 7% of total FN pool (773/11051) — majority of FN are NOT ISM-analyzed.
feature_correlations_noted: GQ>=3 vs QS>=50: 608/728 overlap (83%). GQ>=3 unique: 86 TP (GQ median=9, QS median=0) — these have caller quality signal but no ISM quality signal (QS<50). Lower ISM confidence but real variants.
human_notes: auto-adopted: H012 is best single rescue rule by F1 (+0.009365 > H011 +0.008556). Tradeoff: precision 74.1% vs H011's 76.9%. Both valid; H012 maximizes F1, H011 maximizes precision.

hypothesis: 組合測試：H011(QS>=50) + H012(GQ>=3) + annotation filters 的精密-F1 權衡分析
key_observations: 組合測試結論：(1) H011(QS>=50) ⊂ H012(GQ>=3)，無法正交組合；(2) 所有 annotation 過濾（hp>=0.2, hp>=0.5, VC!=Noise, QS>=20/30/40）均降低 F1；(3) GQ>=3 是此候選池的最優單一規則；(4) 最佳 F1 精度平衡：QS>=50（precision=76.9%, delta=+0.008556）vs GQ>=3（precision=74.1%, delta=+0.009365）。建議根據下游需求選擇：注重 F1 → H012, 注重 precision → H011。
feature_correlations_noted: Combination synergy = 0（H011⊂H012 superset relationship）. Annotation filters consistently reduce F1 by blocking TP. QS>=40 = QS>=50 (no candidates in [40,50) range — QS scores cluster around 0 or >=50). H012+hp>=0.2 ≈ GQ>=5 numerically.
human_notes: auto: combination test complete. GQ>=3 = best F1 rule; QS>=50 = best precision rule. No orthogonal combination possible. Recommend both as parallel annotation tracks.
